citations.assessment: The extant homily introduces Tanhum bar Abba speaking in the name of Hanina, identified as Aha’s father. Warsaw gives Hiyya. Retain the variant as printed.

notes.text: The corresponding Tanchuma clause treats “the father of R. Aha” as appositive to the source of the teaching. Preserve the Warsaw name Hiyya and record the Hanina variant separately.
